image_prompts: A wooden ruler with clear markings on a drafting table
A sign with the text 'No Parking' indicating a regulation
words.image_desc_en: A ruler and a 'No Parking' sign.
words.image_desc_cn: 一把尺子和一个“禁止停车”标志。
words.usage: n. 规则；规律；统治；v. 统治；裁决
words.collocations: as a rule, golden rule, rule of law, rule out

examples.en: The first rule of Fight Club is: You do not talk about Fight Club.
examples.cn: 搏击俱乐部的第一条规则是：不要谈论搏击俱乐部。

examples.en: The king ruled the country wisely for many years.
examples.cn: 国王英明地统治这个国家很多年。

socratic_questions.question: 在游戏中，我们必须遵守什么来保证公平？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 为了公平，我们需要遵循一些必须遵守的条文。

sentences: The teacher set some classroom ___ for the students to follow.

image_prompts: A neatly arranged stack of books on a desk, organized by color
A waiter holding a notepad, taking notes of food choices at a restaurant table
words.image_desc_en: A neat stack of books; a waiter taking food choices.
words.image_desc_cn: 整洁的书堆；服务员记录食物选择。
words.meaning_cn: n. 秩序；命令；v. 命令；点餐
words.usage: n. v. (过去式 ordered, 过去分词 ordered)
words.collocations: in order to, place an order, give an order

examples.en: The teacher asked the students to keep the classroom in order.
examples.cn: 老师要求学生们保持教室的秩序。

examples.en: I will order a pizza for dinner tonight with my family.
examples.cn: 我今晚将和我的家人点一份披萨作为晚餐。

socratic_questions.question: 如果课后教室里一片混乱，老师会怎么做？或者，在餐厅，你想吃东西，你需要做什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 需要恢复平静的状态，或者告诉服务员你想吃什么。

sentences: The police officer gave the driver an ___ to pull over.

image_prompts: Footprints in the snow leading into a dense forest
A winding road through a mountain range, viewed from above
words.image_desc_en: Footprints in snow and a winding mountain road.
words.image_desc_cn: 雪地里的脚印和蜿蜒的山路。
words.collocations: follow instructions, follow a leader, follow closely
words.preposition_combos: follow sb to (a place), follow sb in (doing sth)

examples.en: Please follow the teacher's instructions during the experiment carefully.
examples.cn: 请在实验过程中仔细遵循老师的指示。

examples.en: Many students follow his advice on how to improve their grades.
examples.cn: 许多学生听从他关于如何提高成绩的建议。

socratic_questions.question: 如果有人走在你前面，你做什么才能确保不迷路，并到达同一个目的地？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 你需要做和他一样的动作，走他走过的路。

sentences: You should ___ the rules of the game to avoid penalties.

image_prompts: An alarm clock displaying 7:15 AM with a person's hand reaching to turn it off, indicating being behind schedule
A school bus driving away from a bus stop where a backpack is lying on the ground, suggesting missed transportation
words.image_desc_en: Visuals representing tardiness and missing scheduled events.
words.image_desc_cn: 表示迟到和错过预定事件的视觉效果。
words.usage: 短语，表示未按时到达某地或完成某事
words.collocations: be late for school, be late for work, be late for a meeting

examples.en: I was late for school because my alarm didn't go off.
examples.cn: 我上学迟到了，因为我的闹钟没响。

examples.en: She is often late for class, which affects her grades.
examples.cn: 她经常上课迟到，这影响了她的成绩。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你应该在8点到学校，但你8点15分才到，你会怎么说？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 描述一种没有按时到达的状态。

sentences: He was ___ the meeting because of the heavy traffic.

image_prompts: A stethoscope resting on a medical chart in a brightly lit office
A diploma hanging on a wall above a desk with medical textbooks
words.image_desc_en: Images representing a medical professional and their environment.
words.image_desc_cn: 代表医疗专业人员及其环境的图像。
words.collocations: see a Dr, call a Dr

examples.en: We should see a Dr if the pain does not stop.
examples.cn: 如果疼痛没有停止，我们应该去看医生。

examples.en: Dr. Smith is a famous scientist in our city's research center.
examples.cn: 史密斯博士是我们城市研究中心一位著名的科学家。

socratic_questions.question: 当身体不舒服时，我们通常会寻求谁的帮助？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个职业的人员经过专业训练，可以诊断和治疗疾病。

sentences: Please call ___ Lee; he can help you with your problem.

image_prompts: A chef adding ingredients to a pot, steam rising, creating a delicious dish
A sculptor shaping clay on a pottery wheel, hands working, a form emerging
words.image_desc_en: The image shows the process of creating something, either a dish or a sculpture.
words.image_desc_cn: 图片展示了创造某物的过程，无论是菜肴还是雕塑。
words.collocations: make sb happy, make sb do sth

examples.en: Good grades make her parents proud of her achievements.
examples.cn: 好成绩使她的父母为她的成就感到骄傲。

examples.en: The loud music made me feel uncomfortable at the party.
examples.cn: 派对上嘈杂的音乐让我感到不舒服。

socratic_questions.question: 如果某件事让你感到高兴或悲伤，这件事对你做了什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这件事导致了你的情绪变化。

sentences: Did the movie ___ you cry at the end?

image_prompts: A fork in a road with signs pointing in two different directions, overcast sky
Two doors side by side, one painted blue and the other green, both slightly ajar
words.image_desc_en: A choice between two options.
words.image_desc_cn: 在两个选项之间选择。
words.collocations: either...or

examples.en: You can either study hard or fail the exam; it's your choice.
examples.cn: 你可以努力学习，或者考试不及格；这是你的选择。

examples.en: Either John or Mary will bring the cake to the party tonight.
examples.cn: 约翰或者玛丽今晚会带蛋糕来参加聚会。

socratic_questions.question: 如果我有两个方案，我只允许你选择其中一个，你会怎么表达？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 表示“两个中的一个”的选择。

sentences: You can ___ stay here or go home, but you can't do both.

image_prompts: A chess board with one side having significantly more pieces, indicating a strategic advantage
A runner ahead of all other competitors, clearly winning a race, representing an advantage
words.image_desc_en: Chess pieces showing strategic advantage; a runner winning a race.
words.image_desc_cn: 国际象棋棋子展示战略优势；赛跑者赢得比赛。
words.collocations: take advantage of, have an advantage over

examples.en: Learning English well gives you a big advantage in job hunting.
examples.cn: 学好英语在求职中会给你带来很大的优势。

examples.en: Our team had the advantage of playing on our home field.
examples.cn: 我们队有在主场比赛的优势。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你比别人拥有更多的资源或更好的条件，这会给你带来什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 想想在比赛中领先或在学习中拥有更多帮助。

sentences: Having good time management skills is a great ___ for students.

image_prompts: A piano keyboard with sheet music, indicating musical training
A basketball hoop in a gymnasium with a basketball in mid-air, showing sports training
words.image_desc_en: Practising involves repeated training to improve skills.
words.image_desc_cn: 练习涉及重复训练以提高技能。
words.usage: v. (过去式 practised, 过去分词 practised); n. practice (美式拼写)
words.collocations: practise regularly, practise daily, practise a skill

examples.en: I practise English every day to improve my speaking skills.
examples.cn: 我每天练习英语来提高我的口语技能。

examples.en: We should practise more before the important English test.
examples.cn: 在重要的英语考试之前，我们应该多加练习。

socratic_questions.question: 为了在考试中取得好成绩，你需要做什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 需要反复做题，熟悉题型。

sentences: You should ___ your pronunciation if you want to speak fluently.

image_prompts: A colorful mobile with stars and moons suspended from a ceiling
A framed photograph attached to a wall with a nail
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations of objects being suspended or attached to something.
words.image_desc_cn: 物体被悬挂或附着在某物上的插图。
words.usage: v. (过去式 hung, 过去分词 hung)
words.collocations: hang up, hang out, hang around

examples.en: Please hang your coat on the hook behind the door.
examples.cn: 请把你的外套挂在门后的挂钩上。

examples.en: We like to hang out at the park after school.
examples.cn: 我们喜欢放学后在公园里闲逛。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你想把一幅画固定在墙上，你会怎么做？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 你需要用某种方式把画固定住，让它不会掉下来。

sentences: Did you ___ the washing out to dry in the sun?

image_prompts: A group of colorful backpacks leaning against a brick wall outside a school building, sunlight
A collection of skateboards and scooters parked haphazardly near a park entrance
words.image_desc_en: Backpacks and skateboards representing spending time with friends.
words.image_desc_cn: 书包和滑板代表与朋友们共度时光。
words.usage: v. (过去式 hung out, 过去分词 hung out)
words.collocations: hang out with friends, hang out at the mall, hang out together
words.preposition_combos: hang out at, hang out with

examples.en: I like to hang out with my friends after school.
examples.cn: 我喜欢放学后和我的朋友们一起出去玩。

examples.en: We often hang out at the park on weekends.
examples.cn: 我们经常在周末的时候在公园里闲逛。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你和朋友们没有特别的计划，只是想一起度过一些轻松的时光，你会做什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示一种放松的、非正式的社交活动。

sentences: They like to ___ ___ at the new coffee shop downtown.

image_prompts: A calendar page showing Monday to Friday highlighted in yellow
A digital clock displaying the time on a screen, with the day of the week clearly visible as 'Monday'
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations representing the days from Monday to Friday and a digital clock showing the day of the week.
words.image_desc_cn: 分别代表周一到周五的插图，以及一个显示星期的数字时钟。
words.collocations: on a weekday, every weekday

examples.en: I usually wake up at 7 a.m. on a weekday.
examples.cn: 我通常在工作日的早上七点醒来。

examples.en: The library is less crowded on a weekday afternoon.
examples.cn: 工作日的下午，图书馆不那么拥挤。

socratic_questions.question: 除了周末，你通常在哪几天上学或工作？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 指的是一周中需要工作或学习的日子。

sentences: She goes to the gym every ___ morning before work.

image_prompts: A wilted bouquet of flowers lying on a dusty table, grey filter
A dark, stormy sky with lightning striking a barren landscape
words.image_desc_en: Wilted flowers; a stormy landscape.
words.image_desc_cn: 枯萎的花朵；暴风雨天气下的风景。
words.collocations: awful experience, awful weather, feel awful

examples.en: The food at that new restaurant was absolutely awful, a waste.
examples.cn: 那家新餐厅的食物太糟糕了，简直是浪费钱。

examples.en: I had an awful headache yesterday, so I stayed home all day.
examples.cn: 我昨天头疼得厉害，所以一整天都待在家里。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你参加完一个活动，感觉非常不愉快，你会用什么词来形容你的感受？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词形容令人非常不快或不舒服的体验。

sentences: The traffic was ___ this morning; I was late for school.

image_prompts: A caterpillar transforming into a butterfly, time-lapse photography
An acorn sprouting and growing into a large oak tree, several years passing
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations showing the process of transformation and growth.
words.image_desc_cn: 展示转变和成长过程的插图。
words.collocations: become popular, become friends, become a doctor

examples.en: He wants to become a teacher after he graduates from college.
examples.cn: 他大学毕业后想成为一名老师。

examples.en: The weather will become colder as winter is approaching quickly.
examples.cn: 随着冬天的临近，天气会变得越来越冷。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你努力学习，你最终会怎么样？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 指的是通过努力，状态或身份发生改变。

sentences: She hopes to ___ a famous writer someday with hard work.

image_prompts: A thermometer showing a rising temperature, indicating improvement
Two pie charts, one showing a small slice and the other showing a larger slice, representing improvement
words.image_desc_en: Visual representations of improvement or being in a more desirable state.
words.image_desc_cn: 表示改善或处于更理想状态的视觉表现。
words.meaning_cn: adj. 更好的；adv. 更好地
words.collocations: feel better, get better, better than

examples.en: I hope you feel better soon after taking the medicine.
examples.cn: 我希望你吃了药后能感觉好些。

examples.en: It's better to arrive early than to be late for class.
examples.cn: 早到总比上课迟到好。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你的朋友生病了，你希望他怎么样？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 希望他身体状况有所改善。

sentences: She sings much ___ than I do; her voice is beautiful.

image_prompts: A silhouette standing in front of a brightly lit doorway
A passport photo booth with a single chair and a camera
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations representing an individual.
words.image_desc_cn: 代表个体的插图。
words.usage: 名词 n. (复数 persons 或 people)
words.collocations: in person, young person, each person
words.preposition_combos: person in charge, person of interest

examples.en: Each person needs to bring their own lunch to the picnic.
examples.cn: 每个人都需要自带午餐去野餐。

examples.en: That person over there is wearing a very colorful hat today.
examples.cn: 那边的那个人今天戴着一顶非常鲜艳的帽子。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你想描述一个独立的个体，你会用什么词？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词指的是一个个体，而不是群体。

sentences: Each ___ must show their ID card before entering the building.

image_prompts: A camera lens focusing on a flower in a garden, shallow depth of field
A beam of light converging to a single bright point on a dark surface
words.image_desc_en: A camera lens focusing on a flower and a light beam converging to a point.
words.image_desc_cn: 相机镜头聚焦在花朵上，光束汇聚成一点。
words.usage: v. (过去式 focused, 过去分词 focused)；n.
words.collocations: focus on, main focus, lose focus

examples.en: We should focus on our studies before the final exams.
examples.cn: 我们应该在期末考试前专注于学习。

examples.en: The main focus of the meeting was the new project plan.
examples.cn: 会议的主要焦点是新的项目计划。

socratic_questions.question: 当你准备考试时，最重要的是什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 指的是将你的注意力放在学习上，而不是其他事情。

sentences: It's important to ___ on your goals to achieve success.

image_prompts: A single spotlight shining brightly on a stage, highlighting a specific point
A magnifying glass held over a document, clearly showing a single word
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations representing concentration and attention to detail.
words.image_desc_cn: 表示集中注意力和关注细节的插图。
words.collocations: focus on studies, focus on details, focus on goals

examples.en: We should focus on our studies before the final exams.
examples.cn: 我们应该在期末考试前专注于学习。

examples.en: It's important to focus on the task at hand now.
examples.cn: 现在专注于手头的任务非常重要。

socratic_questions.question: 当你在课堂上听讲时，你应该把你的注意力放在哪里？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 指的是把你的注意力集中在某件事情上，而不是分散。

sentences: You need to ___ your homework to get good grades.

image_prompts: A set of colorful building blocks arranged into a small tower
A blueprint for a modern house with architectural details
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations depicting the concept of construction and creation.
words.image_desc_cn: 描绘建造和创造概念的插图。
words.collocations: build a house, build trust, build a relationship

examples.en: They plan to build a new school near the park.
examples.cn: 他们计划在公园附近建造一所新学校。

examples.en: We should build strong friendships with our classmates.
examples.cn: 我们应该与我们的同学建立牢固的友谊。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你想盖一栋房子，你需要做什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示从无到有地创造或组装某物。

sentences: The students are working together to ___ a robot for the competition.

image_prompts: A glowing, ethereal orb floating in a dark forest, casting light on the trees
A group of colorful flags waving enthusiastically at a sports event, creating a sense of excitement
words.image_desc_en: A glowing orb and waving flags representing enthusiasm and energy.
words.image_desc_cn: 发光的球体和挥舞的旗帜，代表热情和活力。
words.collocations: team spirit, school spirit, in good spirit

examples.en: The team showed great spirit despite losing the important game.
examples.cn: 尽管输了重要的比赛，这支队伍还是表现出了极佳的精神。

examples.en: She tried to keep her spirit up during the difficult exam period.
examples.cn: 在艰难的考试期间，她努力保持乐观的情绪。

socratic_questions.question: 当团队遇到困难，但仍然互相支持、积极向上，这是什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 指一种积极的、团结一致的心态。

sentences: The students showed a lot of school ___ during the sports day.

image_prompts: A magnifying glass hovering over a complex maze, representing contemplation
A lightbulb illuminating above a stack of books, symbolizing deep thought
words.image_desc_en: Magnifying glass over a maze; lightbulb above books.
words.image_desc_cn: 放大镜在迷宫上方；灯泡在书堆上方。
words.collocations: think about the future, think about problems, think about solutions

examples.en: I often think about my future career after graduation.
examples.cn: 我经常思考毕业后的职业生涯。

examples.en: We should think about how to protect our environment better.
examples.cn: 我们应该思考如何更好地保护我们的环境。

socratic_questions.question: 当你面临一个难题，需要寻找解决方法时，你会做什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 需要认真地、反复地在脑海中进行分析和判断。

sentences: Please ___ the consequences before you make a decision.

image_prompts: A hammock strung between two palm trees on a tropical beach, gentle waves in the background
A steaming cup of herbal tea next to a book on a soft, comfortable armchair
words.image_desc_en: Visuals representing relaxation: a hammock on a beach and tea by a comfy chair.
words.image_desc_cn: 代表放松的视觉元素：海滩上的吊床和舒适椅子旁的茶。
words.collocations: relax and enjoy, relax completely, relax for a while

examples.en: After the exam, I want to relax and watch a movie.
examples.cn: 考试结束后，我想放松一下，看场电影。

examples.en: You should relax more; stress is bad for your health.
examples.cn: 你应该更放松一些；压力对你的健康有害。

socratic_questions.question: 当你感到紧张或疲惫时，你会做什么来让自己感觉更好？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词描述的是一种减轻压力和恢复平静的状态。

sentences: After a long day at school, I like to ___ by listening to music.

image_prompts: A handwritten note with the words 'Seek wise counsel' on a wooden desk
A compass pointing towards the word 'Guidance' in a vintage map
words.image_desc_en: Visuals representing guidance and counsel.
words.image_desc_cn: 代表指导和建议的视觉效果。
words.collocations: give advice, take advice, ask for advice

examples.en: My parents always give me good advice about my studies.
examples.cn: 我的父母总是给我关于学习的好建议。

examples.en: I need some advice on how to prepare for the exam.
examples.cn: 我需要一些关于如何准备考试的建议。

socratic_questions.question: 当你遇到难题，不知道该怎么做时，你会向谁寻求什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 通常是长辈或有经验的人给出的，帮助你做出更好决定的东西。

sentences: I followed her ___ and it helped me a lot.

image_prompts: A lightbulb illuminating above a complex maze, representing comprehension
A jigsaw puzzle with most pieces connected, but one piece being placed to complete it
words.image_desc_en: Visual representations of comprehension and completion.
words.image_desc_cn: 理解和完成的视觉表现。
words.collocations: understand the meaning, understand the problem, easily understand

examples.en: I don't understand the question. Can you explain it again?
examples.cn: 我不明白这个问题。你能再解释一遍吗？

examples.en: It's important to understand different cultures when you travel.
examples.cn: 旅行时了解不同的文化是很重要的。

socratic_questions.question: 当你听到别人说话，并且知道他们想表达什么时，你做了什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示你接收并处理了信息。

sentences: Did you fully ___ the teacher's explanation of the math problem?

image_prompts: A room with clothes scattered on the floor and bed, books piled haphazardly on a desk
A messy workbench with tools and materials strewn about, unfinished projects visible
words.image_desc_en: Visual representations of a disorganized and messy space.
words.image_desc_cn: 杂乱无章的空间的视觉表现。
words.collocations: untidy room, untidy desk, untidy appearance

examples.en: His room is always untidy, with clothes all over the floor.
examples.cn: 他的房间总是很乱，衣服扔得到处都是。

examples.en: An untidy desk can make it hard to find important documents.
examples.cn: 一张凌乱的桌子会让人很难找到重要的文件。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你看到一个房间里东西乱七八糟地堆放着，你会用什么词来形容这个房间的状态？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词描述的是缺乏秩序和整洁的状态。

sentences: The student's desk was so ___ that the teacher asked him to clean it.

image_prompts: A train pulling into a station platform, sunlight reflecting off the metal
An airplane landing on a runway, tire smoke visible
words.image_desc_en: A train arriving at a station; a plane landing.
words.image_desc_cn: 火车到达车站；飞机着陆。
words.collocations: arrive at a place, arrive on time
words.preposition_combos: arrive in (a city/country), arrive at (a specific location)

examples.en: We should arrive at the school gate before 7:30 a.m.
examples.cn: 我们应该在早上七点半之前到达学校门口。

examples.en: The train will arrive in Beijing at 10 o'clock tonight.
examples.cn: 火车将于今晚十点到达北京。

socratic_questions.question: 经过长途跋涉，最终到达目的地，你会用哪个动词来描述这个过程？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 表示经过一段时间的旅程后到达某个地点。

sentences: The bus will ___ at the station in about ten minutes.

image_prompts: A clock showing 9:00 AM with a calendar marked for the same date, emphasizing punctuality
A train arriving at a station platform precisely as scheduled, digital display showing arrival time
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations emphasizing punctuality and adherence to schedules.
words.image_desc_cn: 强调准时和遵守时间表的插图。
words.collocations: arrive on time, be on time, get on time

examples.en: The school bus always arrives on time in the morning.
examples.cn: 校车早上总是准时到达。

examples.en: It is important to be on time for your job interview.
examples.cn: 面试准时到达非常重要。

socratic_questions.question: 如果约定的时间是上午九点，而你正好在九点到达，这意味着什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 表示你没有迟到，也没有早到，正好是约定的时间。

sentences: The meeting will start ___ ___, so please don't be late.

image_prompts: A long, empty hallway with doors on either side, soft lighting
An antique hallway with a patterned rug and a grandfather clock
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations of a hallway.
words.image_desc_cn: 走廊的插图。
words.collocations: down the hallway, in the hallway
words.preposition_combos: down the hallway, along the hallway, in the hallway

examples.en: I saw him walking down the hallway to the library.
examples.cn: 我看见他沿着走廊走向图书馆。

examples.en: The classroom is at the end of the long hallway.
examples.cn: 教室在长走廊的尽头。

socratic_questions.question: 在学校里，连接不同教室或办公室的狭长通道通常被称为什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 它通常很长，而且两边都有门。

sentences: The principal's office is located at the end of the ___.

image_prompts: Rows of neatly folded school uniforms on a shelf in a store
A stack of different colored shirts and pants, all the same style
words.image_desc_en: Neatly arranged school uniforms; A stack of identical clothing.
words.image_desc_cn: 整齐摆放的校服；一堆款式相同的衣服。
words.usage: n. 制服; adj. 统一的
words.collocations: school uniform, wear a uniform, uniform size, uniform color

examples.en: Our school requires every student to wear a school uniform daily.
examples.cn: 我们学校要求每个学生每天都穿校服。

examples.en: The soldiers wore a green uniform during the military exercise.
examples.cn: 士兵们在军事演习中穿着绿色制服。

socratic_questions.question: 为了方便管理，很多学校要求学生穿的服装是怎样的？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这种服装款式和颜色都一样。

sentences: The company's employees are required to wear a ___ to work.

image_prompts: Scattered plastic bottles and wrappers on a park lawn, sunny day
A overflowing trash can with paper and food scraps spilling onto the sidewalk
words.image_desc_en: Scattered trash and overflowing waste.
words.image_desc_cn: 散落的垃圾和溢出的废物。
words.collocations: pick up litter, drop litter

examples.en: Please don't litter in the park; keep it clean for everyone.
examples.cn: 请不要在公园里乱扔垃圾；保持公园清洁，为了大家。

examples.en: We should all help pick up litter to protect our environment.
examples.cn: 我们都应该帮忙捡垃圾来保护我们的环境。

socratic_questions.question: 在野餐后，如果地上有很多用过的餐巾纸、塑料袋和食物残渣，这是什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 指随意丢弃的废弃物，与保持环境清洁相反。

sentences: It is important to not ___ and keep our school clean.

image_prompts: A thank you note with elegant cursive writing on a clean desk
A neatly arranged table setting with silverware and a folded napkin
words.image_desc_en: Representations of good manners and etiquette.
words.image_desc_cn: 礼貌和礼仪的象征。
words.usage: adj. Showing good manners and respect for others.
words.collocations: polite to someone; polite request; polite smile

examples.en: It is polite to say 'thank you' after receiving a gift.
examples.cn: 收到礼物后说“谢谢”是有礼貌的。

examples.en: She sent a polite email to the teacher about her absence.
examples.cn: 她给老师发了一封关于她缺席的礼貌邮件。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你想给别人留下好印象，你会怎么做？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 需要表现出尊重和良好的行为举止。

sentences: It's always ___ to listen when someone is speaking to you.

image_prompts: A beautifully decorated cake on a stand, surrounded by colorful balloons and confetti
A first aid kit with bandages, antiseptic wipes, and a small bottle of medicine
words.image_desc_en: Cake and first aid kit.
words.image_desc_cn: 蛋糕和急救箱。
words.meaning_cn: v. 对待；治疗；款待 n. 款待；乐趣
words.collocations: treat someone with respect, treat a disease, a special treat

examples.en: We should treat everyone with kindness and understanding in school.
examples.cn: 在学校里，我们应该以友善和理解对待每一个人。

examples.en: The doctor will treat your cold with some medicine and rest.
examples.cn: 医生会用一些药物和休息来治疗你的感冒。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你朋友心情不好，你会怎么做让他开心起来？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 考虑用一些特别的方式来让他感觉更好，比如请他吃东西或一起玩。

sentences: It's a special ___ to go to the cinema on a Friday night.

image_prompts: A framed certificate of achievement hanging on a wall, spotlight
A bronze statue of a wise owl perched on a stack of books
words.image_desc_en: A symbol of honor and admiration.
words.image_desc_cn: 荣誉和钦佩的象征。
words.usage: n. / v. (过去式 respected, 过去分词 respected) / adj. respectable
words.collocations: show respect, mutual respect, earn respect

examples.en: We should respect our teachers and their hard work always.
examples.cn: 我们应该始终尊敬我们的老师和他们的辛勤工作。

examples.en: It is important to respect different cultures and traditions.
examples.cn: 尊重不同的文化和传统非常重要。

socratic_questions.question: 当你看到某人帮助弱小，并且坚持原则时，你会产生什么感觉？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这种感觉是发自内心的，表示你对他的行为和品质的认可。

sentences: We should always ___ our elders and listen to their advice.

image_prompts: A winding road diverging into two separate paths, one leading to a bright cityscape, the other to a dark forest
A closed door with a question mark on it, a key lying on the floor in front of it
words.image_desc_en: Two different scenarios representing conditional possibilities.
words.image_desc_cn: 代表条件可能性的两种不同场景。
words.collocations: if...then, if only, even if, as if

examples.en: I will go to the park if it doesn't rain tomorrow.
examples.cn: 如果明天下雨，我就不去公园了。

examples.en: She will be happy if she gets good grades on the exam.
examples.cn: 如果她考试取得好成绩，她会很高兴。

socratic_questions.question: 你怎样表达“在某种情况下，某事将会发生”？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词用来引出一个条件，说明某事发生的可能性。

sentences: I'll call you ___ I have any news about the trip.

image_prompts: A neatly folded denim jacket on a wooden shelf in a clothing store
A bright red waterproof jacket hanging on a hook in a hallway
words.image_desc_en: A denim jacket and a red waterproof jacket.
words.image_desc_cn: 一件牛仔夹克和一件红色防水夹克。
words.collocations: wear a jacket, put on a jacket, take off a jacket

examples.en: I need a warm jacket because the weather is getting colder.
examples.cn: 我需要一件暖和的夹克，因为天气越来越冷了。

examples.en: She wore a stylish jacket to the school party last night.
examples.cn: 她昨晚穿着一件时髦的夹克去参加学校聚会了。

socratic_questions.question: 天气转凉时，为了保暖，你会穿什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 一种短款的外套，通常有拉链或纽扣。

sentences: He always wears his favorite blue ___ to school every day.

image_prompts: A calendar with a circled date and an alarm clock ringing loudly
A sign with the words 'MUST DO' in bold letters against a bright background
words.image_desc_en: A calendar reminding of an obligation and a sign indicating necessity.
words.image_desc_cn: 日历提醒义务，标志指示必要性。
words.usage: 情态动词，表示必要或义务
words.collocations: have to do something, have to be somewhere

examples.en: I have to finish my homework before I watch TV.
examples.cn: 我必须在看电视之前完成我的作业。

examples.en: We have to arrive at school before eight o'clock.
examples.cn: 我们必须在八点之前到达学校。

socratic_questions.question: 如果明天有一个重要的考试，你现在最需要做什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 为了准备考试，你需要完成某件事。

sentences: You ___ study hard for the upcoming English test.

image_prompts: A collection of diverse objects scattered on a table, representing all possibilities
A panoramic view of a vibrant city skyline at night, symbolizing limitless opportunities
words.image_desc_en: A collection of diverse objects and a vibrant city skyline.
words.image_desc_cn: 各种各样的物品集合以及充满活力的城市天际线。
words.collocations: everything is possible, everything goes well, lose everything
words.preposition_combos: everything about, everything for, everything in

examples.en: I have lost everything in the fire, but I'm still alive.
examples.cn: 我在火灾中失去了一切，但我还活着。

examples.en: She gave everything she had to help those in need.
examples.cn: 她奉献了她所拥有的一切来帮助那些需要帮助的人。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你在一场比赛中投入了你所拥有的全部资源和精力，你会怎么描述你的投入？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 指代你所拥有的全部资源和精力。

sentences: He promised her ___ she wanted if she passed the exam.

image_prompts: A hand giving a pencil to another hand, focus on the pencil
An open book with a bookmark sticking out, next to a pair of glasses
words.image_desc_en: A pencil being lent and an open book.
words.image_desc_cn: 一支铅笔被借出和一本打开的书。
words.collocations: lend a hand, lend support, lend money

examples.en: Could you lend me your pen? I forgot mine today.
examples.cn: 你能把你的笔借给我吗？我今天忘记带我的了。

examples.en: My friend will lend me his bike for the weekend trip.
examples.cn: 我的朋友将把他的自行车借给我用于周末旅行。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你需要某样东西，而你的朋友同意暂时给你使用，这是什么行为？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个行为不是买或送，而是暂时提供使用。

sentences: I can ___ you my notes if you promise to return them.

image_prompts: A close-up shot of a honeycomb dripping with golden honey, glistening in sunlight
An assortment of colorful candies and lollipops arranged on a white surface
words.image_desc_en: Honeycomb dripping honey; colorful candies.
words.image_desc_cn: 滴着蜂蜜的蜂巢；五彩缤纷的糖果。
words.usage: adj. 甜的；令人愉快的；n. 糖果；甜点
words.collocations: sweet dreams, sweet smile, sweet music

examples.en: This apple pie is very sweet; I like it so much.
examples.cn: 这个苹果派非常甜；我非常喜欢它。

examples.en: She always has a sweet smile for everyone she meets.
examples.cn: 她总是对遇到的每个人都报以甜美的微笑。

socratic_questions.question: 如果食物尝起来像加了很多糖，你会用哪个词来形容它的味道？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 描述一种像糖或蜂蜜的味道。

sentences: The lemonade was too ___ , so I added some water.

image_prompts: A variety of colorful snacks arranged on a wooden table, overhead shot
A vending machine filled with different kinds of snacks, brightly lit
words.image_desc_en: Various snacks displayed; a vending machine full of snacks.
words.image_desc_cn: 展示的各种零食；装满零食的自动售货机。
words.usage: n. / v. (过去式 snacked, 过去分词 snacked)
words.collocations: have a snack, afternoon snack, healthy snack

examples.en: I usually have a snack after school around four o'clock.
examples.cn: 我通常在放学后四点左右吃点零食。

examples.en: She snacked on some cookies while watching her favorite TV show.
examples.cn: 她一边看她最喜欢的电视节目，一边吃了一些饼干。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你在两餐之间感到有点饿，你会吃什么来填饱肚子？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 它不是正餐，但可以暂时缓解饥饿感。

sentences: He always keeps a ___ in his bag in case he gets hungry.

image_prompts: A clear blue sky with fluffy white clouds, indicating certainty
A sign with the words 'YES' in bold letters, confirming agreement
words.image_desc_en: A clear sky and a 'YES' sign, representing certainty and agreement.
words.image_desc_cn: 晴朗的天空和一个“是”的标志，代表确定和同意。
words.collocations: of course not, of course I will

examples.en: Of course, I will help you with your English homework.
examples.cn: 当然，我会帮你做英语作业的。

examples.en: She said she would come, and of course, she did.
examples.cn: 她说她会来，当然，她来了。

socratic_questions.question: 当别人问你是否愿意帮忙，你想表达非常乐意，你会怎么说？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 表示同意和肯定，语气自然。

sentences: A: Can you lend me your pen? B: ___, here you are.

image_prompts: A modern smartphone displaying a vibrant social media feed.
A portable charging bank connected to a smartphone with a charging cable.
words.image_desc_en: Images depicting a smartphone and a portable charger.
words.image_desc_cn: 描绘智能手机和便携式充电器的图像。
words.collocations: mobile phone, mobile app, mobile device, mobile internet

examples.en: I use my mobile phone to listen to music every day.
examples.cn: 我每天都用手机听音乐。

examples.en: The mobile library brings books to people in rural areas.
examples.cn: 流动图书馆将书籍带给农村地区的人们。

socratic_questions.question: 如果一个东西可以很容易地被携带和使用，你会怎么形容它？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词形容某物便于携带和使用，比如手机。

sentences: She always keeps her ___ phone charged for emergencies.

image_prompts: A modern smartphone displaying a vibrant social media feed
A shattered smartphone screen showing a distorted reflection of a cityscape
words.image_desc_en: A device used for communication and various applications.
words.image_desc_cn: 用于通讯和各种应用的设备。
words.collocations: use a mobile phone, mobile phone case, mobile phone signal
words.preposition_combos: on a mobile phone, with a mobile phone

examples.en: I use my mobile phone to listen to music every day.
examples.cn: 我每天用手机听音乐。

examples.en: She forgot her mobile phone at home before going to school.
examples.cn: 她上学前把手机忘在家里了。

socratic_questions.question: 如果想随时随地与朋友保持联系，你会使用什么设备？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 它是一种便携式的通讯工具，可以打电话、发短信和上网。

sentences: He always keeps his ___ charged for emergencies.

image_prompts: A hand reaching to switch off a light switch, energy saving concept
A faucet with water droplets, being turned off tightly, preventing water waste
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations depicting the action of stopping the flow of electricity or water.
words.image_desc_cn: 描绘停止电流或水流动的动作的插图。
words.meaning_cn: 关掉，关闭（电器、水龙头等）
words.collocations: turn off the lights, turn off the engine, turn off the tap

examples.en: Please turn off the lights when you leave the classroom.
examples.cn: 离开教室时，请关掉灯。

examples.en: Remember to turn off the water while brushing your teeth.
examples.cn: 记住刷牙时要关掉水。

socratic_questions.question: 当你离开房间时，为了节约能源，你会做什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个动作是停止电器运行。

sentences: Don't forget to ___ the TV before you go to bed.

image_prompts: A long line of suitcases waiting at airport baggage claim
A digital display showing a list of tasks waiting to be processed
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations depicting a line of suitcases and a digital task list, representing the concept of waiting in order.
words.image_desc_cn: 描绘一队行李箱和数字任务列表的插图，代表按顺序等待的概念。
words.meaning_cn: n. 队伍；队列；v. 排队
words.collocations: join the queue, jump the queue, in a queue

examples.en: People often queue for hours to get the best concert tickets.
examples.cn: 人们经常排队几个小时才能买到最好的音乐会门票。

examples.en: We had to queue up for ages to see the exhibition.
examples.cn: 我们不得不排很长时间的队才能参观展览。

socratic_questions.question: 在餐厅高峰期，很多人在做什么等待座位？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词描述了人们按顺序等待的状态。

sentences: Please form a ___ to buy your lunch in the cafeteria.

image_prompts: A long line of toy cars waiting at a miniature toll booth, one car bypassing the line on the shoulder
A digital illustration of a winding line of shopping carts with one cart moving ahead of the others
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations depicting bypassing a waiting line.
words.image_desc_cn: 描绘了绕过等待队伍的插图。
words.usage: v. to cut in line; to go ahead of others who are waiting
words.collocations: try to jump the queue, be accused of jumping the queue

examples.en: It's rude to jump the queue; everyone is waiting patiently.
examples.cn: 插队是很不礼貌的；每个人都在耐心等待。

examples.en: He tried to jump the queue at the movie theater, but failed.
examples.cn: 他试图在电影院插队，但是失败了。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你在排队，有人直接走到队伍前面，这是什么行为？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个行为是不遵守规则，提前于其他等待的人。

sentences: It is considered impolite to ___ in many cultures.

image_prompts: A hand scattering birdseed on a wooden bird feeder in a garden
A baby bird with its mouth open wide, waiting for food from its parent
words.image_desc_en: Images depicting the act of providing food to animals or infants.
words.image_desc_cn: 描绘给动物或婴儿喂食行为的图像。
words.collocations: feed on, feed the animals, feed information

examples.en: We should feed our pets regularly to keep them healthy.
examples.cn: 我们应该定期喂养宠物，以保持它们的健康。

examples.en: Did you feed the cat before you left for school?
examples.cn: 你上学前喂猫了吗？

socratic_questions.question: 如果你有一只宠物，你需要做什么来保证它不饿？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 需要给宠物提供食物。

sentences: Please remember to ___ the fish every day after school.

image_prompts: A train departing from a station, blurred motion
An autumn tree shedding its leaves onto the ground
words.image_desc_en: A train departing and leaves falling from a tree.
words.image_desc_cn: 一列火车正在离开，以及树叶从树上掉落。
words.usage: v. (left, left) 离开，留下；n. 许可，休假
words.collocations: leave a message, leave school, leave home
words.preposition_combos: leave for (前往), leave sth. to (把...留给)

examples.en: Please leave your phone number, and I will call you back.
examples.cn: 请留下你的电话号码，我会给你回电话。

examples.en: We will leave Beijing for Shanghai next Monday morning.
examples.cn: 我们下周一早上将离开北京前往上海。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你结束了一段旅程或者结束了一天的工作，你会做什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示从一个地方转移到另一个地方，或者把某物留在某地。

sentences: Don't ___ your books on the desk; put them away.

image_prompts: An empty school desk with a closed textbook and a single fallen leaf
A calendar with one date crossed out in red ink, the surrounding dates circled
words.image_desc_en: An empty desk and a marked calendar represent being away.
words.image_desc_cn: 空桌子和被标记的日历代表缺席。
words.collocations: absent from, absent-minded
words.preposition_combos: absent from school, absent without leave

examples.en: He was absent from school because he had a bad cold.
examples.cn: 他因为重感冒而缺席了学校。

examples.en: She is often absent from the meetings, which is quite annoying.
examples.cn: 她经常缺席会议，这很令人恼火。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你的朋友今天没有来上学，你会说他怎么样了？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 考虑他没有在学校出现的状态。

sentences: She was ___ from class yesterday because she had a doctor's appointment.

image_prompts: An empty desk in a classroom, sunlight streaming through the window
A calendar with a specific date circled and marked with a large 'X'
words.image_desc_en: An empty desk and a marked calendar, symbolizing absence.
words.image_desc_cn: 空着的课桌和被标记的日历，象征缺席。
words.collocations: be absent from school, absent from work

examples.en: He was absent from school because he had a bad cold.
examples.cn: 他因为重感冒而缺席了学校。

examples.en: She will be absent from the meeting due to a prior engagement.
examples.cn: 由于事先有约，她将缺席会议。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你的朋友今天没有来上课，你会说他怎么样了？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 考虑他没有在学校这个事实，用一个短语来表达。

sentences: She was ___ the party because she had to study for her exams.

image_prompts: A library reading room with soft lighting and stacks of books, emphasizing silence
A sleeping cat curled up on a cushion, undisturbed in a peaceful room
words.image_desc_en: A scene representing silence and peace.
words.image_desc_cn: 代表安静和祥和的场景。
words.collocations: speak quietly, move quietly, work quietly

examples.en: She quietly closed the door so as not to wake anyone.
examples.cn: 她安静地关上门，以免吵醒任何人。

examples.en: The students worked quietly in the library during the exam week.
examples.cn: 考试周期间，学生们在图书馆里安静地学习。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你不想发出任何声音，你会怎么做？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词描述的是一种没有声音或很少声音的状态。

sentences: He entered the room very _____, hoping not to disturb anyone.

image_prompts: A leather belt buckle fastening on a pair of denim jeans, close-up
A black conveyor belt moving packages in a warehouse, automated system
words.image_desc_en: A leather belt and a conveyor belt.
words.image_desc_cn: 一条皮带和一条传送带。
words.collocations: seat belt, wear a belt, conveyor belt
words.preposition_combos: around the belt, under the belt

examples.en: He always wears a belt to keep his pants from falling down.
examples.cn: 他总是系腰带，以防止裤子掉下来。

examples.en: Remember to fasten your seat belt before the car starts moving.
examples.cn: 记住在汽车启动前系好安全带。

socratic_questions.question: 为了防止裤子松动，我们需要在腰间系上什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 一种环绕腰部的条状物，通常由皮革或布料制成。

sentences: She tightened her ___ to make her dress fit better.

image_prompts: A sound wave graphic emanating from a loudspeaker, indicating high volume
A busy city street intersection with traffic and construction sounds, depicted as sound wave visuals
words.image_desc_en: Loud sounds or disturbances.
words.image_desc_cn: 嘈杂的声音或干扰。
words.collocations: make a noise, background noise, loud noise

examples.en: The loud noise from the street kept me awake last night.
examples.cn: 昨晚街上巨大的噪音让我一直无法入睡。

examples.en: Please don't make so much noise; I'm trying to study.
examples.cn: 请不要制造太大的噪音；我正在努力学习。

socratic_questions.question: 当你试图集中注意力时，什么会让你感到烦躁？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 通常指那些不和谐、令人不悦的声音。

sentences: The construction ___ outside my window is very annoying.

image_prompts: A wilted flower in a vase, petals drooping, dark background
An upside-down smiley face drawn in the sand, waves washing it away
words.image_desc_en: Visuals representing sadness and disappointment.
words.image_desc_cn: 代表悲伤和失望的视觉效果。
words.collocations: feel unhappy, deeply unhappy, unhappy about

examples.en: She felt unhappy because she failed the important English exam.
examples.cn: 她感到不高兴，因为她没有通过重要的英语考试。

examples.en: He was unhappy with his score on the science project last week.
examples.cn: 他对上周科学项目的分数不满意。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你考试没考好，或者你最喜欢的球队输了，你可能会有什么感觉？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这种感觉与快乐相反，表示一种负面的情绪状态。

sentences: The student was ___ when he learned he didn't make the basketball team.
